note: Both sets capture the same core facts from the two section drawings: grade level at 0' - 0" and finished floor at 2' - 9 1/2" for both the West and East modules, with quotes that support the claims. Set B binds the conditions slightly more precisely to 'Section - East/West Module' and includes both the finished floor and grade level quotes for the relative-height claims, while Set A restates the grade value as '0 ft' rather than the source's 0' - 0". Set B adds one unconditioned grade-level claim that is redundant with its conditioned ones, a minor triviality rather than an error. Neither set invents values or misbinds components, so the sets are effectively equivalent.
